hypothesis: Retaining old causal factor supports and sharing only context-invariant learned factor RELATIONS lowers cold held-out consequence prediction MSE versus conventional full-basis learners and versus matched separate-context factor relation regressions, without overwriting old functionality.

design.synthetic_generator: E57:invariant-relational-v1, independent seeded 10-bit randomized do-actions, 2 observed nuisance cues; 4 hidden pair parity primitives among 8 of 10 causal/distractor bits; 2 shared relations, context-specific edge and optionally a sign flip or an entirely unmodeled new triple factor. Additive Gaussian noise sigma .20. Generator withheld roles/coefficients from learners.
design.assignments: Exactly 408 unique underlying 10-bit causal actions per world: 96 old training,96 new training,72 held old,72 held new,72 held cold. Cold nuisance cues independent; old/new nuisance cues correlate/anticorrelate with source bits.
design.feature_grammar: Learned old-only primitive pair support via OMP4 over all 66 2-way Walsh products of twelve observed bits; six pairwise products of four old-learned primitives. Selection and identity are not given by oracle; planted roles/relations only used after scoring. Conventional full OMP8/ElasticNet receive all 793 order<=4 Walsh products, plus fully trained RBF KernelRidge and 48-tree ExtraTrees.
design.candidate: Fit OLD OMP4 and old Ridge based on selected 4 primitive pairs + 6 possible pair products. Freeze old predictions exactly. Independently fit OLD and NEW provisional Ridge and mark each of six relations invariant iff BOTH |coef|>=.20, signs equal and coefficient absolute difference <=.35. Fit pooled stage-specific primitive and changing-edge weights but shared invariant-edge weights by Ridge .4, then use NEW predictor for new+cold.
controls: same selected primitive+relation basis, fully fitted SEPARATE OLD and NEW Ridge .3, same 192 labels (matched relation/no pool)
unconditionally pool all edges with same constrained Ridge .4
full order-4 Walsh ElasticNet alpha=.055 l1_ratio=.8 max_iter=2000 tol=.0005 old/new
RBF KernelRidge alpha .25 gamma .20 raw 12 observed bits old/new
48-tree ExtraTrees depth12 min_leaf2 on same labels raw bits old/new
shuffled NEW label relation refit negative
design.information_and_budget: Every arm sees identical 96 old +96 new factual action consequences; all held actions and labels disjoint; candidate old support selected ONLY from 96 old labels, learned invariant gate from witnessed OLD/NEW. No held labels, true support indices or generator roles provided during fit. No active action selection, no native Yggdrasil weights.
design.audit: Separate audit.py independently reconstructs seeded source/latent truths/nuisance contexts, refits all nine methods, checks selected factor pairs and inferred invariant edges, all held predictions and source/held metrics, seed/family aggregates. Shares backend NumPy and scikit-learn; not fully independent scientific replication.
design.compute: Single-core local Python 3.13.5, NumPy2.3.5, SciPy1.17.0, sklearn1.8.0, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1. One prospective two-seed screen and exact-source replay; no paid APIs or owner runner. No physical energy measurement. Process time includes source generation, fit, audit separately.
design.metric: Mean per-world held old/new/cold MSE (lower better). Planted primitive pair exact support recall, selected invariant edge precision & recall against hidden true stage-invariant pair identities. Per-seed and per-family cold mean. Cases retain complete predictions/actions/labels for archive.

frozen_screen_gates.cold_vs_best_conventional_5pct: Pooled candidate cold MSE <=.95 x minimum pooled cold MSE across full_omp/full_elasticnet/rbf_krr/extra_trees.
frozen_screen_gates.cold_vs_separate_relations_3pct: Pooled candidate cold MSE <=.97 x same-discovered-factors fully fitted separate_relations cold MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.both_seed_wins_best_conventional: Candidate cold MSE strictly better than best conventional full_omp/full_elasticnet/rbf_krr/extra_trees WITHIN EACH prospective seed.
frozen_screen_gates.both_seed_no_relational_damage: Candidate cold <=1.02x matched separate_relations for BOTH seed cohorts.
frozen_screen_gates.primitive_support_recall_80pct: Exact planted pair primitives among four old-support pair selections >=80% across 24 prospective worlds.
frozen_screen_gates.invariant_relation_precision_70pct: Among graph relation edges selected for sharing, >=70% truly correspond to latent stage-invariant planted relation edges; if zero edges, FAIL.
frozen_screen_gates.invariant_relation_recall_65pct: Candidate shared relations recover >=65% of all planted stage-invariant pair edges across worlds.
frozen_screen_gates.old_frozen_retention_exact: Candidate old held MSE matches same old support/head in separate_relations and no_adapt in EVERY world to absolute 1e-10.
frozen_screen_gates.all_families_no_degrade_10pct: Candidate pooled cold MSE <=1.10x strongest conventional method in EACH mechanism family.
frozen_screen_gates.shuffled_new_negative_20pct: Candidate pooled cold MSE <=.80x sham-new-label relation learner cold MSE.
frozen_screen_gates.cold_vs_new_robust_150pct: Candidate cold MSE <=1.50x candidate own held new MSE (nuisance distribution shift).

classification.SCREEN_PROMISING: Independent auditor PASS and all critical [cold_vs_best_conventional_5pct,cold_vs_separate_relations_3pct,both_seed_wins_best_conventional,invariant_relation_precision_70pct,old_frozen_retention_exact] PASS, with >=9 of 11 gates overall. Only then eligible for separate frozen 36-world primary; still NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification.SCREEN_NO_GO: If any critical gate FAIL or <9/11 total PASS with fully valid independent audit/source, stop and preserve negative source+data without scoring reserved primary seeds.
classification.INVALID: Source not frozen before prospective score; mismatch SHA/branch/seed; any held labels/roles leaked to fitting; missing conventional controls or action parity; duplicate underlying causal action across train/held streams; audit disagreement; missing original case receipts. Never classify invalid infrastructure as negative science.
classification.unverified: If run or audit cannot finish, no positive/negative scientific conclusion; preserve limitation.
classification.primary: If screen promising, separately freeze primary gate rules on reserved 100019/100043/100057 before scoring and require same-source independent audit. No new tuning on consumed data.

prohibitions: No further tuning on prospective seeds
No native Yggdrasil training, accepted ref mutations, runtime/controller/runner/queue/scheduler changes
No paid API or first-use scientific qualification
